units: Unreal: cm, s (clip time), deg, m/s; x forward, y right, z up, yaw deg (+ toward +y). Blender (x, y, z) m = (100 x, -100 y, 100 z) cm at rig scale, then x game_scale.
actor_frame: x forward along the dragon's nose, y right, z up; origin = rig origin on the floor at frame 0, moved by the track. The C++ adds its own mesh-in-actor offset and yaw.

air_hover.air_note: hover loop at the hover pose height

air_land.air_note: descent from hover to the ground stance (touchdown frame 90)

annotations.name: touchdown
annotations.note: feet planted by IK from frame 90 (authored; the fit's landing frames are unreliable)

air_fire_down.air_note: hover, body pitched nose-down, jaws open pointing down

annotations.name: fire_down_hold
annotations.note: jaws open to 40 deg and the head pointing down; Niagara fire timed on this window (refine jaw envelope: open by 80, shut from 160)
